svg.style: background: #0f172a; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

g.text: Step-by-step coordination between Consumer, Broker, Active Controller, Group Coordinator, and Followers
KAFKA CLUSTER (Brokers, Active Controller, Group Coordinator)
Consumer starts and wants to join Group
Asks: Who is the Leader for _consumer_offsets P23?
ACK sent once followers update their partition logs.
Leader waits for all ISR followers to sync.
Broker 3 waits for all followers to update events in topic "_consumer_offsets" partition 23.
There is no option to configure (ack=0 or 1 or all) — Internally Consumer offset commit acts like Ack=All!
Once all followers get latest update, Group Coordinator sends response:
Where did the previous consumer leave off?
Consumer offset details are NOT Cluster metadata. They are stored like normal topic data in _consumer_offsets.
Offset data is NOT stored in Controller nodes (avoids overloading Controller with continuous commits).
Invokes Leader Broker of Topic Partition
Knows last processed offset was 100 → requests next offset 101
Log Segment Lookup & Event Batch Assembly:
Reads partition log starting from offset 101 up to max.poll.records / 200 bytes limit.
Events ready to transfer: Offsets 101 to 501
Sends commit request: offset processed till = 501
Offset safely written and replicated across ISR followers.
Loop continues: next poll() initiates next batch fetch
↺ Move back to Step 8 (Fetch from offset 502)
Coordinator is the leader broker for partition:
Every group deterministically maps to a single broker coordinator.
Offsets are stored as normal topic messages in _consumer_offsets.
Offsets are NOT stored in the Controller node, preventing metadata bottleneck.
When committing offsets to Coordinator, Broker 3 waits for all followers to replicate.
No ack=0/1 option exists; offset commits are strictly durable.
Consumer fetches event data directly from the Partition Leader (Broker 2), NOT the coordinator.
Coordinator only manages group membership & offsets.
